revision: V4 (audited): builds on the V3 audited base with a fourth hardening pass. Prompt-injection isolation -- unmistakable === N. ... === section headers (the evidence sanitizer turns an attacker's <...> into [...], so bracketed headers were forgeable), untrusted evidence and covenant terms wrapped in <untrusted_evidence_data> / <covenant_terms> tags whose closing tags cannot be forged (< and > are stripped), and a hard CRITICAL SECURITY DIRECTIVE. Ground-truth telemetry bounding corridors in _clamp_tier: a full sanction (CRITICAL_BREACH) is forbidden below BPS_ELEVATED (2500) -- capped to ELEVATED_RISK with corroborating evidence, else NORMAL -- and MALICIOUS_REPORT is forbidden at/above BPS_CRITICAL (7500), floored to NORMAL so an honest high-telemetry plaintiff never loses its whole bond. The equivalence round now carries the judicial rationale: leader() returns json.dumps({verdict, rationale}), prompt_comparative compares both the verdict tier and the legal coherence of the rationale, and the decided tier is parsed back out for deterministic settlement. Live party-attributed telemetry endpoints served from two independent public CDNs.
